== Introduction ==

High power, moderate destiny, and the potential to win a drain race.

== Strategy ==

Well I haven't played in a long while.  So this is the first deck I am building since...i want to say last Jan.  Any help will be greatly appreciated.

The basic focus of this deck is to beat the snot out of your opponet, and for the opponet who doesn't want to come out and play there should be more than enough drain potential at Jabba's Palace.  As for starting.  Check to see your opponets Objective (or lack there of one).  Start Tatooine (system) then use combat readiness to pull Jabba's palace.  However, if your opponet pulls WYS, Start Jabba's Palace and Combat Readiness for the cantina ( this way you can activate there, plus the system is already on the table).   Thats all i can really say about the deck.  If there is some feed back with questions about card selection, I will update.
